news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nai Rail Line Ka Nirmaan, Simeanchal Ke Liye Railwey Ki Khaas Planning
bullets: Bihar mein nai rail line ka nirmaan kiya ja raha hai, jo Simeanchal ke liye railwey ki khaas planning ke tahat aata hai, isse is kshetra ki surat badalne ki ummeed hai.
Is project ke liye koi vishisht budget outlay nahi di gayi hai, lekin yeh project Bihar ke vikas ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, ismein kai nai rail line ka nirmaan shamil hai.

Bihar sarkar ne is project ko pramukhata di hai, kyunki yeh project Bihar ke vikas ke liye avashyak hai, isse Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, aur yeh project Bihar ke aarthik vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega.

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein MoU Par Haste, 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh Hoga
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh audyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh Bihar mein hoga.
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel hub ka vikas hoga, sath hi textile aur nuclear energy sector ko bhi badhava milega, isse Bihar ke aarthik vikas mein vriddhi hogi.

Bihar sarkar ne is MoU ko pramukhata di hai, kyunki yeh MoU Bihar ke vikas ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, isse Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, aur yeh MoU Bihar ke aarthik vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega.

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwastariya Swaroop
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne JP Ganga path ko vishwastariya swaroop dena ka faisla kiya hai, iske liye kai vikas karyon ko prarambh kiya jayega.
Is project ke liye 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega, isse Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, aur yeh project Bihar ke aarthik vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega.

Bihar sarkar ne is project ko pramukhata di hai, kyunki yeh project Bihar ke vikas ke liye avashyak hai, isse Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, aur yeh project Bihar ke aarthik vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega.
